previous_story: Two miles beneath the Pacific, sub-pilot Nora tracked a ghost signal. A rusty 1950s submarine suddenly materialized alongside hers. Inside its cockpit stood a handsome naval officer, holding a sign to the glass: *I’ve waited seventy years for you.* Nora gasped as he pressed his palm against the window. Just as she touched hers to his, her oxygen failed and the glass cracked. Come back for the next part tomorrow.
